review_id: 1009
entity_slug: cobalt-the-restaurant

rating: 5
review_text: 5-Stars!!

We visited Cobalt with our family of four, and it was just as exceptional as we remembered from our last visit in 2021.

The atmosphere was beautiful, especially sitting outside on the patio with a view of the bay.

The weather was perfect, and the setting made the whole evening feel special.

Our waiter, Zac, was terrific. He was attentive, courteous, and very professional throughout the meal.

He kept our waters filled, checked in regularly, and made sure we had everything we needed.

Service was also very quick, especially considering how busy the restaurant was.

The food was top shelf from start to finish. We started with the sautéed claws and the chips with Cobalt cheese dip, and both were very tasty.

My wife and I also shared a dozen fresh oysters, which were excellent.

For dinner, my son had the DIY cheddar hamburger and said it was the best hamburger he has ever had.

My daughter had the pork loin and loved it. I had the black and red fish with hot crab, and it was exceptional.

My wife had the bronzed grouper and really enjoyed it.

The prices are definitely on the higher side, but if you want a great atmosphere, excellent service, and five-star food, Cobalt is worth it.

We arrived around 5:00 and only waited a couple of minutes to be seated.

There was plenty of parking, and the restaurant was easy to find.

Overall, this was another outstanding experience, and we are glad we came back.

Highly recommended.

rating: 5
body: Cobalt is a restaurant, but originally it’s a color whose meaning is associated with calmness, often symbolizing luxury and tranquility. You’re surrounded by calming blues in Cobalt the restaurant at Alabama Point, right next to the Perdido Bay Bridge, just beautiful blue watery-hues everywhere to be seen. Sit outside when weather permits, and ask for a window table when it’s hot.🥗 We actually watched Cobalt being built while staying at Caribe one winter, we’ve been patrons that long, and it’s maintained the same top notch level of service and good food since the beginning. Our favorites are the Firecracker Shrimp and the Shrimp Po’Boy Sandwich. Get the shrimp. They do shrimp really well. 🧁 Their bakery at the front has excellent sweets. Their bathroom is so nice. The bar stays busy. The whole restaurant stays busy - especially in summer- but they have tons of seating. Live music is a bonus. Cobalt is one of my favorite restaurants anywhere. It’s a coastal Alabama must do.

--- entity_reviews [row 5 of 5] ---
id: a889e529-0642-4001-ba7d-00d376ae0a44
entity_slug: cobalt-the-restaurant
reviewer_name: Carlos Arnavat
rating: 5
body: 5-Stars!!

We visited Cobalt with our family of four, and it was just as exceptional as we remembered from our last visit in 2021.

The atmosphere was beautiful, especially sitting outside on the patio with a view of the bay.

The weather was perfect, and the setting made the whole evening feel special.

Our waiter, Zac, was terrific. He was attentive, courteous, and very professional throughout the meal.

He kept our waters filled, checked in regularly, and made sure we had everything we needed.

Service was also very quick, especially considering how busy the restaurant was.

The food was top shelf from start to finish. We started with the sautéed claws and the chips with Cobalt cheese dip, and both were very tasty.

My wife and I also shared a dozen fresh oysters, which were excellent.

For dinner, my son had the DIY cheddar hamburger and said it was the best hamburger he has ever had.

My daughter had the pork loin and loved it. I had the black and red fish with hot crab, and it was exceptional.

My wife had the bronzed grouper and really enjoyed it.

The prices are definitely on the higher side, but if you want a great atmosphere, excellent service, and five-star food, Cobalt is worth it.

We arrived around 5:00 and only waited a couple of minutes to be seated.

There was plenty of parking, and the restaurant was easy to find.

Overall, this was another outstanding experience, and we are glad we came back.

Highly recommended.

ref_type: business
ref_id: cobalt-the-restaurant
entity_slug: cobalt-the-restaurant
title: Cobalt the Restaurant
category: seafood_restaurant
subtitle: Brian and Jodi Harsany’s interpretation with this unique restaurant affords local and visitors the opportunity to experience coastal cuisine at its finest. For over ten years, Cobalt has provided the ultimate in waterfront dining with its unparalleled views, first-rate service and exceptional catering.

Chef Reed Moody, Executive Chef, loves to cook and this love started him in the kitchen at a young age. He attended Faulkner State and studied Culinary Arts. In his role as Executive Chef he looks forward to continuing Cobalt’s tradition of great food along the Gulf Coast and also expanding our reach with the use of fresh and local ingredients.

Chef Nick Norman, Chef de Cuisine, is a Pensacola native and has been with us since 2012. He loves experimenting with Latin cuisine and cultivating these elements into the dishes here at Cobalt. In addition, he loves the challenge of alcohol and food fusion with unique pairings and intense flavor profiles.

Chef Rush Golden, Sous Chef, has been with our family of restaurants for the last nine years, mostly recently at GTs On The Bay. His love of Southern cooking puts a spin on Gulf Coast favorites and we are excited to have him here at Cobalt. He enjoys the restaurant business because there’s always something new to learn and he is constantly thinking of ways he can improve.

Chef Jeffrey Palmer, Sous Chef, has been with us since 2018. He became one of our Sous Chefs in 2022.
